name: Pyramid Protocol
description: A research lab beside the pyramids is training the syndicate's machine. Its core vault lies in the tower at the west end, three floors of tomb and hall away. As the soldier, run the guarded floors, hall first, then the upper and lower tombs. As the hacker, stay on the catwalks above them: fetch USB keys, hack the security doors and put on the goggles to cross the gap on hidden steps. Both routes meet at the tower, where the password waits behind one more door.
